items.briefing:
Ransomware attacks are increasing while organisations' ability to recover from backups is getting worse — a concerning trend for Australian businesses, including training organisations. Separately, Microsoft has released a massive round of security updates this month, patching nearly 1,000 vulnerabilities across its products. If your organisation uses Microsoft software (which most do), ensure IT has applied these updates promptly.

Phishing threats are also evolving, with attackers now using legitimate Google links to disguise malicious URLs, making them harder to spot. UNSW Sydney has also launched ChatGPT Edu for 80,000 users — a reminder to ensure staff understand acceptable use policies before using AI tools with sensitive data.

**Tip:** If you receive an unexpected link — even one appearing to come from Google — hover over it before clicking, and when in doubt, don't click.

featured.title: OpenAI & UNSW Sydney launch ChatGPT Edu for 80,000
